name: Flare
gap: First insider unlock date NOT confirmed. Facts found: TDE (launch) was 2023-01-09 with 4.279B FLR (15% of the public allocation) airdropped (ForkLog 2023-03-17, https://forklog.com/en/flare-team-begins-distributing-flr-tokens-worth-714-million/; FIP.01 summary https://medium.com/flarenetwork/flare-improvement-proposal-01-fip-01-summary-implementation-5087dfcec72a, which does not say insiders got tokens at TDE). Flare docs FAQ (https://flare-docs-cookbook.vercel.app/support/flr) says for Flare Foundation and Flare Labs 'their distribution doesn't begin until month six', team members are 'restricted from selling any of their tokens for the first six months' and 'may sell no more than 25% within the first 18 months', and most recipients get allocations 'gradually and consistently over the full 36 months' - implying insider releases began around July 2023 (inside the window) as a gradual stream, but no exact date or amount is published; the sell-restriction wording leaves open whether team wallets held tokens from the TDE. CryptoPotato 2023-10-13 (https://cryptopotato.com/flare-announces-2-1b-flr-burn-to-safeguard-community-holdings-and-attract-new-users/) says remaining backer tokens 'were provided earlier that week' and ~2.1B of backer tokens are burned instead (198.9M at once, 66.29M monthly to Jan 2026). CoinDesk 2024-02-23 (https://coindesk.com/business/2024/02/23/layer-1-network-flare-raises-35m-from-kenetic-aves-lair) says early-investor distribution originally due in 2024 was voluntarily pushed to Q1 2026 with sales capped at 0.5% of daily volume (relocked/delayed, outside window). TokenRadar (https://tokenradar.ai/tokens/flare/tokenomics) has no release dates for team/backers/foundation. No single-day unlock >=25% of circulating confirmed: monthly FlareDrops were 676M FLR (~16% of the ~4.28B circulating right after TDE, shrinking in % thereafter) and are community distributions, not insider; the month-six insider start could not be sized or dated. Price check: ~$0.03 in March 2023 (derived from ForkLog's $714M / 24.2B).
